text:
Zoe (Design): Dropped a micro-proposal for a 'suppression timeline' in the rule preview. Goal: inline compact timeline that shows recent suppressions, when they started, and if they were inherited vs direct. Figma: https://figma.redwood/suppression-timeline-compact Amir (PM): Love it. Key asks: make the timeline scannable for on-call — 1 line per event, short verb phrase (e.g., \"Silenced by night window\", \"Team override applied\"). Also show timezone context. Tess (Frontend): Implementation idea: render as a horizontal micro-list with icons + `title` for full copy. Use a11y-friendly abbreviations and a longer offscreen summary for SR: `

Suppression timeline: most recent - silenced by night window at 02:13 local

`. Liu (A11y): Good start. Prefer vertical list when there are >3 events to avoid cramped announcements. Use `aria-live=\"polite\"` when the timeline updates and include explicit timestamps in the announced text: \"Suppression added: night window, started 02:13, inherited from Team Ops\". Avoid relying on color alone for event types. Rafael (SRE): Add last-eval and last-match to each event if available. Also show whether a fallback would have fired for that event (e.g., \"fallback: email after 3 failures\"). That helped root cause in last incident. Zoe (Design): Updated mock: 1-line compact rows, small provenance tag (team vs rule), and tiny clock hint like \"02:13 local\". If >3 events, show a +n collapsed indicator that expands into full list. Amir (PM): Copy tweak: prefer \"silenced until\" vs \"silenced by\" when end time exists. Example: \"Silenced until 07:00 (local) — applied by Night window\". Makes it easier to scan. Tess (Frontend): For expansion pattern use ARIA disclosure: `` toggles an adjacent `
    `. When collapsed, ensure hidden items have `aria-hidden=true` and are removed from tab order. Also virtualize long lists. Liu (A11y): When collapsing, update the `aria-live` region with a concise summary: \"3 suppression events hidden; expanded view available\". Use `aria-controls` from the button to the list region. Ensure focus moves into the list when opened. Rafael (SRE): Edge case: show a \"stale\" flag when the preview used cached policy data older than 30s. Small badge: \"snapshot 00:02m old\". Teams assumed live rules in previous tests and it confused them. Zoe (Design): I'll add a `preview snapshot` pill and change banner copy to: \"Preview uses snapshot from 2025-02-14T02:13Z (2m old)\". Also will change visible verbs per Amir's suggestion. Amir (PM): Also request: ensure the timeline is included in shareable snapshots and that shared links mask sensitive rule names. Tess (Frontend): Noted. API will return `masked: true|false` for each event. We'll mask client-side if needed. Example payload: `[{eventType: 'quiet', start: '...', masked: true}]` (we'll use snake_case on wire). Liu (A11y): Final checklist I'll verify on PR: live region announcements, focus management with disclosure, readable timestamps for SR, color-independent indicators. preview-bot: preview build succeeded https://preview.redwood/alerts/suppression-timeline?branch=timeline-compact Zoe (Design): Thanks all 44D. I'll iterate the mock with the new pill + copy and mark it opt-in behind feature flag. Please shout with any blockers before EOD.
